All,

messages.subject: RE: Project Lyra — SIGNED — executed licence attached
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Delighted to confirm the HRX-218 Patent and Know-How Licence is now signed by both parties. Conformed executed copy attached (PDF). Key agreed terms for your records: £6m upfront (payable by 13 Feb); milestones to £44m development / £105m sales; royalties 8/11/14%; liability cap the greater of £10m or 12 months' payments, with IP warranties and confidentiality uncapped; first Phase II long-stop 30 June 2028.

Congratulations to the team. James will circulate the post-completion steps (patent recordal, technology transfer, first JSC).

Sarah

--
Sarah Whitfield | Partner, Corporate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0118
